definitions.explanation: The act of ending or canceling an ongoing contract, subscription, or agreement.

examples.japanese: {携帯|けいたい}{電話|でんわ}の{契約|けいやく}を{解約|かいやく}する。
examples.english: To cancel a mobile phone contract.

examples.japanese: {解約|かいやく}{手続|てつづ}きはオンラインでできます。
examples.english: Cancellation procedures can be done online.

examples.japanese: {解約|かいやく}には{違約金|いやくきん}が{掛|か}かる{場合|ばあい}があります。
examples.english: Cancellation may incur a penalty fee.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a noun or with する to form a verb.
- {解約|かいやく}する: to cancel (a contract)
- {解約|かいやく}{手続|てつづ}き: cancellation procedure

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {契約|けいやく}を{解約|かいやく}する: to cancel a contract
- {定期|ていき}{購読|こうどく}を{解約|かいやく}する: to cancel a subscription
- {保険|ほけん}を{解約|かいやく}する: to cancel an insurance policy

RELATED TERMS:
- {解約金|かいやくきん}/{違約金|いやくきん}: cancellation fee/penalty
- {解約|かいやく}{手数料|てすうりょう}: cancellation processing fee
- {途中|とちゅう}{解約|かいやく}: early termination

CONTRAST:
- {契約|けいやく}: contract (entering into)
- {更新|こうしん}: renewal
